tools.name: server_info
tools.description: Name, canonical endpoint, and support contact for this server. Says which tools need a plan that includes receipts. No sign-in required.

tools.name: list_data_sources
tools.description: List every external dataset Verzi ingests, with license, update cadence, and last-loaded state. No sign-in required. No patient data.

tools.name: check_dme_coverage
tools.description: Look up Medicare coverage for one durable medical equipment (DME) HCPCS Level II code in a US state on a date of service. Returns the Local Coverage Determination (LCD) and policy articles in force on that date with CMS links, whether the code is on the Medicare prior authorization list, and the doc

tools.name: get_documentation_requirements
tools.description: For one DME HCPCS code and date of service, list the governing LCD and policy article names, CMS links, section headings, and how many requirements are extracted. An anonymous caller also gets one sample requirement. The rest of the passage text, and the denial sentences, require a plan that include

tools.name: search
tools.description: Search public Verzi pages for a HCPCS code, an LCD, an article, or denial language. Each result has an id, a title, and a verzi.health URL. No sign-in required. Codes only, no patient data.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch one public Verzi page by id (code:E0601, lcd:L33718, article:A52467, or denials:E0601). Returns the page title, text, and verzi.health URL. No sign-in required. Codes only, no patient data.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_dme_coverage" references sensitive artifacts (authorization). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
